title: CI setup-python action: fail fast when uv cannot download the requested Python version
answers: CI job fails while provisioning Python with uv even though the fixture requires that version; why does the failure happen?
Where does the GitHub Actions setup step decide whether the selected Python version is available to uv on this runner?
I need to add a new Python version or platform check to the CI setup; which step runs after setup-uv and what does it validate?
How is the error message for an unavailable uv Python download produced in the workflow?
body:
Path: .github/actions/setup-python/action.yml (composite action, runs:steps) resolves the Python version from get-python-version, sets up uv via setup-uv, and then runs the "Check uv Python support" step before dependency install. Every CI job that uses this action passes through it.
Rule: After setup-uv, validate the selected version with `uv python list "$PYTHON_VERSION" --all-versions --only-downloads` (version passed via env from steps.get-python-version.outputs.version). If the output is empty, emit `::error::` naming `$(uv --version)` and the version, point to required-version in pyproject.toml, and exit 1. Do this kind of catalog check (no download) when adding similar version gates.
Symptom: CI jobs failed when the pinned uv (0.11.14) could not provision Python 3.10.21 on the runner platform, even though the fixture required that exact version, so the failure surfaced late and without a clear reason.
Constraints: Applies only to the setup-python composite action in CI. It does not download Python, change version pins, enumerate platforms, or alter workflow triggers. The check only confirms the uv catalog lists a downloadable build for the current platform.
applies: CI setup for GitHub Actions workflows that call .github/actions/setup-python; not for runtime MLflow code or local developer environments.
says: Test pipelines fail late with confusing errors when an unsupported runtime version is requested.
Fail early with a clear message if the package installer cannot download the runtime.
Why does automated testing fail to provision the specific patch version needed by tests?
Test execution crashes during package installation because the runtime binary is unavailable for this platform.
Make test jobs report immediately when a requested programming language version is missing.
search: In .github/actions/setup-python/action.yml, a validation step runs after setup-uv to fail fast if uv cannot provision the requested Python version. The check runs uv python list "$PYTHON_VERSION" --all-versions --only-downloads using the version from steps.get-python-version.outputs.version, emitting an error with uv --version, referencing pyproject.toml required-version, and exiting with code 1 if empty. This catalog check prevents late failures that occur when pinned uv versions cannot provision required micro-versions on runner platforms. Applies solely to the CI setup-python composite action without downloading Python, changing version pins, or modifying runtime code.
